translate_en|mods/GrowingUp/42/media/lua: You are 8 years old. No skills, no occupation. <LINE> Every 90 days you age one year. Drive at 14, grow up at 18.
Nobody messed with you at recess. You're bigger than the other kids, meaner too — but not exactly honor roll material.
Everything scares you. You cry at thunderstorms, eat when you're nervous, and the other kids never let you forget it. Good luck.
Fastest kid at school and MVP of the Little League team. Strong, brave, and always first picked — but books put you right to sleep.
You devoured every Goosebumps book the school library had. You learn fast and read faster, but you bruise easy and loud noises make you jump.
You spent every summer at the creek catching crawdads and building forts. You know the woods like the back of your hand.
You always tagged along with the older kids but never said much. Nobody notices you — and honestly, that's how you like it.
You are a child. Small, weak, and scared. You'll grow out of it... if you survive.
